spellbook.finance/limitations: A claim is durable and idempotent for the same workspace. Claiming another workspace is refused; this tool cannot move a prior claim.

Free Seller access must be enabled for the selected workspace. The soft 10,000-unit usage allowance is not an access gate. The response reports claim state and this caller's immediate Seller entitlement. It creates no Store trial, paid subscription, marketplace connection, or listing.

description: Select one workspace for free Seller access. Ask the seller to name the workspace from spellbook_workspaces_list and confirm that choice before this call. Never pick a workspace from list order or an active-workspace default. The signed-in person must own it. Re-read spellbook_workspace_plan_status after this call for the access state and observed usage.

choiceConfirmed.description: True only after the seller explicitly confirms this workspace choice in the current conversation. Required.

workspaceId.description: The exact workspaceId the seller explicitly selected for their one free Seller workspace. Required.

name: spellbook_free_seller_workspace_claim
